Sophie (Support): Customer reporting sudden 400s on POST /v1/rerank — they say payload looks correct on their side. Spike started ~09:12 UTC.

Sophie (Support): example client payload they sent (raw):
```json
{"items": [{"id":"a1","text":"candidate 1"}], "queries": ["which is best?"], "top_k": 1}\x00\x00
```

Sophie (Support): server response: 400 Bad Request, body: {"error":"bad_request","message":"json: invalid character '\\x00' after top-level value"} request_id=rid_7f9a

Devin (Runtime): that exact error string implies trailing NUL bytes after the JSON. Go's json.Decode errors that way. Could be mobile client appending a c-string terminator or a bug in their gzip wrapper.

Miguel (SDK): customer on mobile-sdk v2.3.1 — we've seen a regressed Buffer concat in that release that can append sentinel bytes when compressing. Repro snippet: 
```js
const payload = JSON.stringify(req);
const buf = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(payload), Buffer.from([0,0])]);
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank', { method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: buf });
// server returns 400 with json: invalid character '\\x00' after top-level value
```

Sophie (Support): client handed us a hexdump: `7b 22 69 74 65 6d ... 7d 00 00` (so two 0x00 bytes appended).

Sandeep (ML): note: even if items were empty we'd return a validation 400 later, but here parsing fails first. If we silently strip trailing NULs we reduce customer friction but must be explicit in logs.

Devin (Runtime): proposed mitigation: trim trailing 0x00 and 0xEFBBBF (BOM) bytes before JSON decode in the public handler, emit metric `rerank.malformed_trailing_bytes` and return the same 400 but with more diagnostic info in logs. I'll open a canary PR.

Miguel (SDK): workaround for customers: upgrade to mobile-sdk v2.3.2 (patch coming) or on their side ensure gzipping/compression step doesn't append terminator. Quick curl repro (works to reproduce):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary $'{"items":[{"id":"a1","text":"candidate 1"}],"queries":["which is best?"],"top_k":1}\x00' \
  -v
# returns 400 with json: invalid character '\\x00' after top-level value
```

Sophie (Support): immediate ask to customer: 1) try resending without trailing nulls, 2) capture failing request_id (rid_7f9a) and raw request bytes (hexdump) and 3) if using mobile-sdk, upgrade to 2.3.2 once available.

Devin (Runtime): created internal ticket INF-4291 to add trimming + metric + canary patch. Will also add a clearer 400 error message text to suggest "trailing null or BOM".

IngestBot: Automated note: linked support ticket #SUP-8892 -> INF-4291.

Sophie (Support): thanks team — looping the customer back with repro steps and asking for request_id if it fails again. :thumbsup:
